Kimi Antonelli is World Champion, Max Verstappen delivers another masterclass, and Charles Leclerc has a weekend to forget!
Meanwhile, MotoGP has given us a championship battle to remember. Marc Marquez's incredible comeback, Ducati's faith in him, Aprilia's missed opportunities and a 44-point turnaround.
All the big debates, opinions and talking points from F1 and MotoGP on Gearbox EP 21.
